speaker: philip_henslowe
text: I am counting heads. The count stays at the door. You had a penny. That is the whole of your business with my hand.

speaker: edward_alleyn
text: You came over. It is a cold day for a penny, and the yard is warm. I am glad of a face that knows what a yard is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It plays. I am glad I came. I will not keep you in the cold for a compliment.

speaker: edward_alleyn
text: Then go home warm. We shall still be here tomorrow, if the river is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow I am in my own house's play. I came today because I was not. God give you a good night.

speaker: philip_henslowe
text: The door is this way. I have heads enough without adding a conversation.
